title: Steel conduit tools
summary: Introduces the parts of a conduit bender, how its sizing gives the minimum bend radius, and the die stock used to thread steel conduit.

sections.heading: Tools for steel conduit
paragraphs: A variety of tools are used to install steel conduit. One of the most popular is the conduit bender.
The top of the conduit bender has four main parts: the roll bar, the roller, the former and the stop bar.

sections.heading: Roll bar and roller
paragraphs: The roll bar is where the pressure is applied to bend the conduit. It has several holes to suit different sizes of conduit. The roller sits within the roll bar and is positioned in the relevant hole depending on the size of conduit being bent.
bullets: Roll bar: pressure is applied here to bend the conduit; several holes for different conduit sizes
Roller: sits within the roll bar and goes in the relevant hole for the conduit size
Safety: always place the roll bar in the down position, as a falling bar can be painful

sections.heading: Former and stop bar
paragraphs: The former is sized so that the minimum bend radius is achieved. The stop bar holds the conduit in place while it is bent.
bullets: Former: sized to ensure a minimum bend radius of 2.5 times the conduit diameter
Stop bar: a bar with several holes giving different positions for different conduit sizes
The stop holds the conduit in place while it is bent

sections.heading: Die stock
paragraphs: A die stock is used to thread steel conduit. The complete set includes a spare guide and die.
bullets: Die stock: used to thread steel conduit
The complete set includes a spare guide and die

quiz.q: Which part of a conduit bender is the point where pressure is applied to bend the conduit?
quiz.why: The roll bar is where the pressure is applied to bend the conduit.

quiz.q: Which position should the roll bar of a conduit bender always be placed in for safety?
quiz.why: The roll bar should always be placed in the down position, as a falling bar can be painful.

quiz.q: What is the minimum bend radius that the former of a conduit bender is sized to achieve?
quiz.why: The former is sized to ensure a minimum bend radius of 2.5 times the conduit diameter.

quiz.q: Which part of a conduit bender holds the conduit in place while it is bent?
quiz.why: The stop on the stop bar holds the conduit in place while it is bent.

quiz.q: Which tool is used to thread steel conduit?
quiz.why: A die stock is used to thread steel conduit.

quiz.q: What does the roller on a conduit bender do?

Cuts the thread on the conduit

options: To suit different sizes of conduit
To allow the former to be removed

quiz.why: The former is sized to ensure the minimum bend radius of 2.5 times the conduit diameter is achieved.
